2609.23371.title: Machine-Interpretable Information: Compiling Documents into Searchable and Readable Protocol States
2609.23371.paper_summary: Long-context language models interface with external knowledge through raw natural language. In retrieval-augmented systems, this creates a persistent index-payload schism: dense vectors enable searchable routing, but models must re-ingest lengthy text payloads for reasoning at O(N^2) attention cost. Existing compression methods further produce private states tied to specific architectures. We introduce Machine-Interpretable Information (MII), the first agent-to-agent (A2A) document-to-state protocol. A dual-timescale state-space Writer compiles documents into a canonical, fixed-bandwidth state (56 tokens), and a lightweight Translator maps it into any frozen Reader's embedding space, reducing query-time cost to O(K). The resulting .mii artifact unifies Retrieval (searchable geometry), Reasoning (global memory), and Reconstruction (grounded details) in a single transferable medium. We demonstrate strong cross-model interoperability across heterogeneous LLMs (e.g., Llama, Qwen, Mistral) -- despite the Writer using a legacy GPT-2 vocabulary, forcing genuine semantic translation rather than token-level memorization. Mechanistic probes reveal modular latent structure: entity representations can be causally traced and zero-shot transplanted between unrelated document states while remaining decodable. To address lexical reconstruction under fixed bandwidth, we propose Residual-MII, a cache hierarchy combining compiled global memory with sparse local evidence. On HotpotQA (7,405 queries), Residual-MII exceeds full-context Exact Match at approximately 7% of the attention FLOPs, suggesting a paradigm shift toward compiled, transferable neural document formats.
2609.23371.paper_summary_zh: 長期上下文語言模型通過原始自然語言與外部知識進行交互。在增強檢索系統中，這造成了一種持久的索引-有效負載分裂：密集向量使可搜索路由成為可能，但模型必須重新吸收冗長的文本有效負載以進行推理，這樣的注意力成本為 O(N^2)。現有的壓縮方法進一步產生與特定架構相關的私有狀態。我們引入機器可解釋信息（MII），這是第一個代理到代理（A2A）文檔到狀態協議。一個雙時間尺度狀態空間寫入器將文檔編譯成一個標準的、固定帶寬的狀態（56 個標記），而一個輕量級翻譯器將其映射到任何凍結的讀取器的嵌入空間，將查詢時間成本降低至 O(K)。生成的 .mii 文檔在單一可轉移介質中統一了檢索（可搜索幾何）、推理（全局記憶）和重建（基於事實的細節）。我們展示了跨異構 LLM（例如 Llama、Qwen、Mistral）之間強大的跨模型互操作性——儘管寫入器使用的是舊版 GPT-2 詞彙，這迫使進行真正的語義翻譯，而不是基於標記的記憶。機械探針揭示了模塊化潛在結構：實體表示可以被因果追溯並在無關的文檔狀態之間零樣本移植，同時保持可解碼性。為了解決在固定帶寬下的詞彙重建，我們提出了殘差 MII，一種結合編譯全局記憶和稀疏本地證據的緩存層次結構。在 HotpotQA（7,405 個查詢）上，殘差 MII 超越了全上下文精確匹配，約為 7% 的注意力 FLOPs，這表明向編譯的、可轉移的神經文檔格式的範式轉變。
2609.23371.author: Yifan Wang et.al.
